related.title: 融合光子網路：遺失旗標與擦除預算
related.titleEn: Fusion photonic networks: loss flags and erasure budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有旗標近似獨立時用此模型；任何新增來源方案須另乘實測選路透射。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use this model only for approximately independent heralds; multiply any expanded design by measured switching transmission. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 分開已知位置的擦除與位置未知的位元錯誤。
related.differenceEn: Separate located erasures from unlocated bit errors.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。每次成功率0.2，並行來源N=4；僅選一個成功來源輸出。 P可用=1−0.8⁴。 代入 1-0.8**4，得到 0.5904 dimensionless。N個獨立相同成功率p的嘗試，其可用率1−(1−p)^N；不含選路損耗。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。每光子保留率0.95，1000個雙光子介面。 期望擦除介面=N(1−η²)。 代入 1000*(1-0.95**2)，得到 97.5 interfaces。獨立雙光子介面至少一個遺失的機率1−η²；遺失位置可觀測不代表能全部修復。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Per-attempt success0.2 withN=4 parallel sources; select only one successful source. Pavailable=1−0.8^4. Substituting 1-0.8**4 gives 0.5904 dimensionless. N independent attempts with successp give availability1−(1−p)^N, before switching loss. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Per-photon survival0.95 across1000 two-photon interfaces. Expected erased interfaces=N(1−η²). Substituting 1000*(1-0.95**2) gives 97.5 interfaces. A two-photon interface loses at least one photon with probability1−η²; locating loss does not guarantee correction. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

Compare individual and ideal crossbar wiring for a16×16 array. Wiring ratio=N²/(2N). Substituting 16**2/(2*16) gives 8 ratio. AnN×N array needsN² individual lines versus2N ideal crossbar lines, a ratioN/2; shielding, readout, trim and redundancy are excluded. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
